operationUnit: one dynamic quoted-string pool selection and explicit clone with one complete retained string
specification: Both quote styles, byte/Unicode/code-point escapes, identity/control escapes and all five line-continuation forms decode at compile time to valid Unicode scalars. Native excludes lone UTF16 surrogates; paired escapes form their scalar.
notes: Whole timed workload includes borrowed input/pool setup, dynamic selection, explicit clone(values[at]), loop and natural String[] retention. TypeScript clone is identity; native ordinary Cow clone shares static literals and independently copies owned input. Complete content observation is outside timing. Quote decoding happens at compile time; these rates describe selection/cloning/retention, never decoding throughput. Ordinary optimization remains allowed; no JavaScript allocation parity claim.
